_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Option 1, 2, & 3 Coating Thinning Certification Report
summary: This DID is used to obtain and track emission data and certification of each preservation coating to be thinned upon option 1, 2 and 3 thinning requirements.
use_relationship:
This DID is used to obtain and track emission data and certification of each preservation coating to be thinned upon option 1, 2 and 3 thinning requirements.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as specified in NAVSEA Standard Item 009-97, Shipbuilding and Ship Repair Operations National Emission Standard for Hazardous Air Pollutants (NESHAPS) for Surface Coating Information.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
The reference document cited in this DID can be obtained as specified in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revision, shall be specified in contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the format similar to that of Attachment A of NAVSEA Standard Item 009-97, Shipbuilding and Ship Repair Operations National Emission Standard for Hazardous Air Pollutants (NESHAPS) for Surface Coating Information.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain all of the information specified in Attachment A of NAVSEA Standard Item 009-97, Shipbuilding and Ship Repair Operations National Emission Standard for Hazardous Air Pollutants (NESHAPS) for Surface Coating Information; and shall also contain the following: Name and hull number of ship; Contract number and job order; Work Item; Work item paragraph number(s); Standard item paragraph number(s).
